scripts.build: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --cwd apps/frontend build && bun run --cwd apps/backend build
scripts.build:indexer: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --cwd apps/indexer build
scripts.dev: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: bun run --cwd apps/frontend dev & bun run --cwd apps/backend dev
scripts.dev:windows: sh ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run dev:apps
scripts.dev:indexer: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --cwd apps/indexer dev
scripts.dev:indexer-windows: sh ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --cwd apps/indexer dev
scripts.dev:frontend: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --cwd apps/frontend dev
scripts.dev:backend: ./scripts/local-development.sh && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --cwd apps/backend dev
scripts.lint:win: set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8096&& biome format . --write && biome lint . --fix
scripts.sync: dotenv -e .env -- bun run --cwd packages/sync sync tokens
scripts.migrations:dev: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --cwd packages/migrations dev
scripts.migrations:build: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --cwd packages/migrations build
scripts.migrations:start: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --cwd packages/migrations start
scripts.start:indexer: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --cwd apps/indexer start
